item.title: What Are Data Contracts?
item.description:
Introduction

Data contracts are formal specifications that define the structure, format, and expectations for data exchange between systems. Think of them as API contracts, but for data pipelines and data products.

Core Concepts

Schema Definition

At the heart of every data contract is a schema that defines:

  • Fields: What data fields are included
  • Types: The data type of each field (string, integer, date, etc.)
  • Constraints: Validation rules (required fields, value ranges, formats)
  • Nested Structures: Complex objects and arrays
